tasks.title: Build and smoke-test a native menu-bar app bundle

local_evidence.swift: Swift app host compiled for arm64-apple-macosx13.0.
local_evidence.smoke: tools/test_macos_app.sh passed for the native host architecture: app bundle/plist/executable checks, bundled loopback server startup, desktop and micro GETs, and refusal to produce an unsigned DMG.
local_evidence.universal: Universal arm64+x86_64 builder and CI smoke passed on the native macOS runner. The runner installed the Intel Rust standard library, checked both Rust and Swift executable slices, and fetched desktop and micro routes from the bundled service.
local_evidence.limitation: The exact-head hosted AppKit menu-action/retry smoke is pending. The local opt-in AppKit launch aborted during restricted LaunchServices registration (SIGABRT); this does not establish a source-level menu failure.

tasks.ci_evidence: Baseline universal code head db452596e8b10a42a5fb6d6187b7b0a30c79413 passed 7/7 jobs in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41778857053; final documentation head 0394056a6c3b381bf64b667ccc0ac382d90f5309 passed 7/7 in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41779843083. Follow-up head 2c6e15446c1414a42a08bc8f3c4c94d3c78d1f14 failed the native macOS job in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41782734765 at the AppKit smoke step; six other jobs passed. Inspection traced the failure to a stale Quit marker assertion after Stop began terminating directly. Commit fd41d089c6e812a5d56786619f0c937a27c05271 run https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41783954586 has six completed jobs successful, while the native macOS AppKit smoke remains in progress and its live job log endpoint returns 404. Review found an unbounded wait in that smoke and a redundant waitUntilExit inside the Process termination handler; the current worktree removes the nested wait and bounds AppKit process waits to 30 seconds. Commit fd41d089c6e812a5d56786619f0c937a27c05271 run https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41783954586 stalled in the AppKit step and was canceled when the next commit arrived. Commit 8f69b5a92194fe2e36b5c12b90e27adeee8942a0 run https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41785148903 reached the same step and remained in progress; live logs were unavailable. Review found nested process waiting and unbounded wait/cleanup paths. Current worktree removes the nested wait, bounds AppKit waits to 30 seconds, and force-cleans only isolated smoke child processes on failure. A new exact-head run is required.
